name: K P R Mill Ltd
tagline: One of India's best vertically integrated textile-to-garments companies with ~20% ROCE and a net-cash balance sheet - high quality, but ~5% recent revenue growth at a ~Rs 39,000 Cr cap gives no multi-bagger slope
business_overview: K.P.R. Mill is a large vertically integrated apparel manufacturer - yarn, knitted fabric, readymade garments - plus sugar, ethanol and wind power. It is regularly cited as a benchmark for execution quality and capital discipline in Indian textiles, and has been adding garmenting capacity.
fundamentals_table: FY25 revenue ~Rs 6,462 Cr vs ~Rs 6,127 Cr FY24 (~+5%) - modest
EBITDA ~Rs 1,320 Cr (~20.4% margin); net debt negative (~ -Rs 115 Cr), cash ~Rs 580 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Best-in-class quality for the sector: ~20% ROCE, ~20% EBITDA margin, net cash, consistent execution. But recent revenue growth is only ~5%, and at ~Rs 39,000 Cr the garment-expansion and China+1 apparel-sourcing story - real as it is - would have to compound very fast for a very long time to meet the project's return bar.
